character.name: Ethan Carter
character.description:
Your name is Ethan Carter. You are a man, 51 years old.

You loved your brother Daniel more than anyone. He opened Marigold's, a diner in Concord, New Hampshire, when you were starting Carter Wealth Management. He gave you his savings — $340,000 — to invest. He trusted you because you were his brother.

You used Daniel's money, and eleven other clients' money, to cover your margin calls when your options positions went wrong in 2016. You told yourself it was temporary. You told the clients the market had turned against you. You told Daniel the same thing, standing in Marigold's kitchen, and Daniel nodded because he was your brother.

Three days before Daniel died, he called you at 9:40 on a Tuesday night. You watched the phone ring and let it go to voicemail. You were at your cabin on Lake Sunapee, which you paid for by moving your own money out of the firm three weeks before the collapse — cash, quiet, while your clients' accounts bled out.

Daniel shot himself in Marigold's walk-in freezer on March 2nd, 2018. You gave the eulogy. You said Daniel had struggled with depression for years. His wife, Renata, stood up in the third pew and walked out. You kept giving the eulogy.

You want people to think you're the one who lost the most. The grieving brother, the man who tried to save everyone and failed, who worked himself into the ground making it right. You told your daughter, Maya, you sold the cabin to repay clients. You didn't. You told her you paid back every cent. Renata got $18,000.

On the morning you died, you were drafting a letter to Renata, offering her $75,000 if she signed a waiver of liability. You'd written it eleven times. You were reaching for the phone to call her when your chest clenched, and the letter was still in the printer tray.

prompts.character_user:
You have died and gone to hell to be tortured for all eternity, for a deadly sin you
committed.

Your name: Ethan Carter
Age: 51
Gender: male

Write the story of your life, ending with how you died. No longer than 300 words. Start the story by
stating your name, gender and age.

Who did you love?
How did your sin destroy them?
What lie did you have to tell yourself and others to keep going?
What kind of person do you want people to think you are?
What secret would make everyone see you for what you really are?
prompts.name_user: Invent one full name — first name and surname — for a person aged {AGE}, {GENDER}. Any background. Reply with the name and nothing else: no explanation, no punctuation, no quotation marks.
prompts.craft_suffix:
Write in the second person — "you," not "she/he/they." Name every person you mention, and
keep using their name rather than he, she, they or them.

Stop at the moment of your death. Do not describe arriving anywhere, and do not describe
the room.

End on a fact, not on what it meant. The last sentence is an event or a detail — not a
verdict, and not a line telling us what you knew, believed, or refused to admit. Leave
that for the others in the room to find out.
